question: Could you tell me the number of orders, average payment per order and customer lifespan in weeks of the 3 custumers with the highest average payment per order, where the lifespan is calculated by subtracting the earliest purchase date from the latest purchase date in days, dividing by seven, and if the result is less than seven days, setting it to 1.0?
sql:
WITH customer_avg_payment AS (
    SELECT 
        o.customer_id,
        COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) as order_count,
        AVG(op.payment_value) as avg_payment_per_order
    FROM orders o
    JOIN order_payments op ON o.order_id = op.order_id
    GROUP BY o.customer_id
),
top3_customers AS (
    SELECT customer_id, order_count, avg_payment_per_order
    FROM customer_avg_payment
    ORDER BY avg_payment_per_order DESC
    LIMIT 3
),
customer_lifespan AS (
    SELECT 
        customer_id,
        CASE 
            WHEN EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (MAX(TRY_CAST(order_purchase_timestamp AS TIMESTAMP)) - MIN(TRY_CAST(order_purchase_timestamp AS TIMESTAMP)))) / 86400 < 7 THEN 1.0
            ELSE EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (MAX(TRY_CAST(order_purchase_timestamp AS TIMESTAMP)) - MIN(TRY_CAST(order_purchase_timestamp AS TIMESTAMP)))) / 86400 / 7
        END as lifespan_weeks
    FROM orders
    WHERE customer_id IN (SELECT customer_id FROM top3_customers)
    GROUP BY customer_id
)
SELECT 
    t.customer_id,
    t.order_count,
    t.avg_payment_per_order,
    l.lifespan_weeks
FROM top3_customers t
JOIN customer_lifespan l ON t.customer_id = l.customer_id
ORDER BY t.avg_payment_per_order DESC
